description: This file defines a centralized API client using Axios for frontend-backend communication in a React application. It includes API configuration, interceptors, and multiple API modules for authentication, user management, recipes, meal plans, social features, and premium subscription handling.

methods.name: loginEmail
methods.description: Performs email/password login and returns authentication data.

methods.name: registerEmail
methods.description: Registers a new user with email, password, and name.

methods.name: requestPasswordReset
methods.description: Triggers a password reset email for the given email.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user session.

methods.name: setPreferences
methods.description: Sets user dietary preferences and allergies.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves meal plan for specified period and start date.

methods.name: setEntry
methods.description: Assigns a recipe to a specific date and meal type.

methods.name: groceryList
methods.description: Generates a grocery list for a plan window.

methods.name: shareRecipe
methods.description: Shares a recipe via backend handling.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Gets current user's premium subscription status.
